identity: Title-page front matter plus the opening of الليمون العجيب (The Marvellous Lemon) by عادل الغضبان, third edition, in the mid-century Egyptian children's series المكتبة الخضراء للأطفال — a literary retelling of the 'love for three oranges' fairy-tale type. Four short title-page lines (series name, title, byline, edition), then seven paragraphs of ornate but syntactically plain fairy-tale narration containing two long orations in direct speech (the prince's plea, the king's remonstrance). Register sits between doctrine §E (graded/folk narrative) and §F (children's magazine story): more ornate than an abridged reader, but built out of the same ف-/ثم-/و- chained narrative steps. Measured on the first 200 tokens the source period runs ~9-15 tokens and the comma-to-comma unit ~7-8, so I set the target segment at ~9 tokens and produced 73 boundaries over 655 tokens (9.0 tok/segment).
law: Punctuation-derived, not semantics-derived (LAW 0). Sentence law as I read it here: (1) every ف-/ثم- resumptive that advances the narrative or opens an explanatory move starts a sentence — this text is a ف-chain and the ف's carry most of the ink; (2) و + a clause with its OWN new subject or new topic NP starts a sentence (LAW 1/C4), including nominal حال clauses that FOLLOW a completed main clause; (3) the counterweight — a LIGHT bare-VP chain sharing one subject rides along inside the sentence (فاصفر واحمر وتمتم وبكى is one segment), but a HEAVY و-verb clause carrying a full object NP plus adjuncts breaks out; weight, not the letter و, is the discriminator; (4) a fronted conditional/temporal protasis (فلما، حينما، إن، حتى إذا) stays welded to its apodosis as one period (C1), and a TRAILING relative, purpose, حتى or إذا adjunct welds backward (LAW 4); (5) a حال clause that INTERRUPTS a main clause between verb and complement welds; one that FOLLOWS a complete clause cuts; (6) each rhetorical question in the king's tirade is its own segment (H2); (7) a short ولكن tail (3-6 tokens) glues to the preceding sentence (B4), a contentful 9-token ولكنه head cuts (T2 length test); (8) phrase-level و joining nouns, PPs or vocatives never cuts; (9) speech verb welds to the opening of its quotation (G1), but a 65-token oration still takes internal sentence boundaries, since no register in the doctrine tolerates segments that long.
reasoning: SITE 46-50, the bride's qualities. عروسا نبيلة غنية جميلة رقيقة الحاشية طيبة القلب is the ONLY asyndetic list in this document; every other list the author writes uses و (مصر والهند والصين، المدن والقرى والقصور والأكواخ، الشقراء والسمراء والحمراء والصفراء والسواد، للرغبة والحزن والضجر). That contrast is internal evidence that the asyndeton here is the trace of removed commas, and LAW 3 says an asyndetic parallel list is cut (cf. يكبر ‖ يزداد طولا ‖ يتضخم). I cut all four, marked lo — it is my least-supported extrapolation, since LAW 3's attested cases are clause- and apposition-level, not NP-internal. I deliberately did NOT extend it to the two-item balanced doublets عبوس الوجه مقطب الجبين (376/378) or مهموما مغموما (511): those are formulaic rhyming pairs that print without commas, and cutting them would fragment a narrative clause. If the key cuts the doublets too, or welds the five-item list, that is a clean isolated correction for the doctrine either way. SITE 189 and 290, the two speech verbs. وقال يخاطب والده and وقال يجيب عن كلام ابنه both took a colon in the source, and A4 plus the LAW 0 corollary say a colon becomes a boundary — but G1 is my strongest recorded over-cutting correction (5 false cuts in batch 1: قالت جو أسرعا لقد حضرت أمنا خبئا السلة is ONE segment). I obeyed G1 and welded both verbs to their quotations, and I likewise welded the vocatives مولاي (190) and يا ولدي ويا عصا شيخوختي ودم قلبي (297) forward into the first sentence of each speech, on the strength of صاحت الفتيات شكرا لك على هدية عيد الميلاد يا مارمي لقد قرأنا... where an internal vocative did not cut. But I did NOT extend G1 to the whole oration: welding 187-254 would make a 68-token segment and 286-367 a 82-token one, and LAW 6's table tops out at 35. I reconciled this by rereading G1's evidence as comma-welding inside short turns, and cut the orations at their ف-resumptives (208 فهذه، 219 فأنا، 233 فإن، 327 فإلى أين، 347 فانف) and at each rhetorical question (303، 306، 334، 339). SITE 384-394, حتى إذا. LAW 4 explicitly forbids cutting before a trailing حتى and says the cut goes AFTER the adjunct, before the next main verb — the exact error I was graded on in doc_56781db1019f (بعد أن). So I welded حتى إذا تعب الملك الشيخ من سكب الدموع وبذل الرجاء to لا يرى إلا الرأي الذي يرضيه and cut at 394, before تنهد. LAW 5 pulled the other way (first available joint) but LAW 4 is the graded finding and wins. SITE 404-447, the king's send-off. فزوده...وأرسل...وضم...وصعد is four verbs on one subject; E2's VP-chain exemption would weld all 44 tokens, which is impossible. I resolved by weight: وبأكياس من النقود (410) is a second PP object of زوده, phrase-level coordination, welded; but وأرسل معه خادمين أمينين (420), وضم هذا الابن العاق إلى صدره مودعا (424) and وصعد ... إلى أعلى برج (431) each carry a full object NP plus adjuncts and break out. I applied the same weight test in reverse at 624 (فزار الأقاليم والأحياء ودخل المنازل والأكواخ) and welded it — light pair, sharing the trailing حال باحثا عن. SITE 129/135 vs 432. Three واو الحال clauses, split by position: وأبوه يكيل له العظة and والأمير مشغول عنها follow a completed clause and have their own topic NP with a nominal predicate, so C4 cuts them; وقلبه يتقصف حزنا interrupts وصعد from its complement إلى أعلى برج, so it welds. That positional rule is new to me and I flag it. SITE 113 and 553, the two ولا-coordinations (فما أثرت فيه بلاغتهم ولا رجعته دموع أبيه / فما أجدى بححثه ولا عثر على الكنز). Each second clause has its own subject, and the pair is parallel, so LAW 1 and LAW 3 both say cut; §C's ولا داخل فيه ولا خارج عنه weld is phrase-level and does not govern. Cut both, med, consistently — they stand or fall together. SITE 603, فقد after a negated clause. T4 (low confidence) predicts weld here since أما الخادمان فلم يستطيعا is negated; LAW 2, backed by ~50 misses, says cut before فقد. I cut, and log this as a direct T4 test. SITE 488/503/649, three short ولكن tails (ولكن لا تبلل، ولكنه لا يجف، ولكنه لم يجد بينهن محبوبته) — all 3-5 tokens, all welded per B4; against 81, where ولكنه كان إذا فوتح بأمر الزواج جمح كالفرس المتوحشة is 9 tokens with its own conditional and gets cut. That is a clean four-point test of T2's length hypothesis inside one document. SITE 491, في حين — B2 attests it opens a segment; LAW 4 would weld it as a trailing subordinate. I cut, because the two rain similes (دموع الطفل / دموع الوالد) are a balanced antithesis that would otherwise run 28 tokens. SITE 162, وتدفق منها الدم واستقر في صحن — welded as one continuous event on one subject; SITE 183, واهتزت نفسه وتغير تفكيره — cut, because each has its own new subject and the pair is parallel. Overall I pushed density to 9.0 tok/segment; batch 1 said I under-cut 5:1, so at every genuine coin flip above I took the cut.
